title: 第一卷 第3章 你太丑了第一卷 第4章 八扇门
slug: 徒儿下山祸害你七个师姐去吧
content_zh:
;;
叶倩文闻言，脸色一冷。
原本略微松懈的心再度一紧。
心中自嘲道，我怎么还能相信这个浑蛋的话？
叶倩文深吸一口气，用手指着门外，对叶青云冷声道。
“你现在！立刻！给我滚出去！”
“倩倩，你不相信我？”
“滚出去！”
叶青云眼见叶倩文如此嫌弃和坚决的表情，心中明悟。
以一位普通人的见识，确实很难理解他掌握的医术。
于是，他认真地对叶倩文说道。
“倩倩，我和你打个赌。”
“什么赌？”
叶倩文表情一顿。
叶青云表情严肃：“如果我能把咱妈的眼睛治好，让她重见光明。
你就认回我这个哥哥。”
叶倩文都没有过多犹豫，直接点头。
“可以，如果你能把妈的眼睛治好。
你就是将功赎罪，我可以认你这个哥。
那如果你治不好呢？”

“我就如你所愿，不踏入这个家一步！”
叶青云一口回道。
“不过，在给咱妈治眼睛前，我得去准备药材。”
“那你在准备好药材后再来吧。
在此之前，还请你不要打扰我们。”
叶倩文说完，直接把叶青云推出去。
这次，叶青云并没有反抗。
就在叶倩文要把门关上的时候。
一道人影出现在她的视线中。
那人开口道。
“倩文，你对我的建议考虑得怎么样了？”
叶倩文的脸上闪过一抹厌恶。
她对面前这位打着耳洞，穿着破洞牛仔裤的青年开口道。
“刘平，我拒绝。”
叶倩文说完，想直接把门关上。
刘平眼疾手快地拉住门把手，开口道。
“没有我，你欠虎哥的那10万块怎么还？”
“这就不劳你费心了。”
“倩文，只要你答应做我女朋友。
那10万块我立马给你还了。

另外，我是真心爱你的。
以后我会和你一起孝敬咱妈的！”
刘平继续说道。
“谢谢你的喜欢，我不接受，你太丑了。”
叶倩文冷声道。
content_en:
;;
Ye Qianwen's face turned cold when she heard this.
My heart, which had been slightly relaxed, tightened again.
I laughed at myself, how could I still believe what this bastard said?
Ye Qianwen took a deep breath, pointed at the door with her finger, and said coldly to Ye Qingyun.
"You now! Immediately! Get out of here!"
"Qianqian, you don't believe me?"
"Get out!"
Seeing Ye Qianwen's disgusted and determined expression, Ye Qingyun understood clearly.
It is indeed difficult for an ordinary person to understand the medical skills he mastered.
So, he said to Ye Qianwen seriously.
"Qianqian, let me make a bet with you."
"What bet?"
Ye Qianwen's expression paused.
Ye Qingyun looked serious: "If I can cure our mother's eyes and let her see the light again.
Just recognize me as your brother. "
Ye Qianwen didn't hesitate too much and nodded directly.
“Yes, if you can cure Mom’s eyes.
If you atone for your sins, I can recognize you as my brother.
What if you can't cure it? "
"I will do as you wish and never step foot into this home!"
Ye Qingyun replied in one breath.
"However, before treating my mother's eyes, I have to prepare some medicinal materials."
“Then you can come back after preparing the medicinal materials.
Until then, please don't disturb us. "
After Ye Qianwen finished speaking, she directly pushed Ye Qingyun out.
This time, Ye Qingyun did not resist.
Just when Ye Qianwen was about to close the door.
A figure appeared in her sight.
The man spoke.
"Qianwen, how have you considered my suggestion?"
A flash of disgust flashed across Ye Qianwen's face.
She said to the young man in front of her who had pierced ears and wore ripped jeans.
"Liu Ping, I refuse."
After Ye Qianwen finished speaking, she wanted to close the door directly.
Liu Ping quickly grabbed the door handle and spoke.
"Without me, how would you pay back the 100,000 yuan you owe Brother Hu?"
"That won't bother you."
"Qianwen, as long as you agree to be my girlfriend.
I will pay you back the 100,000 yuan immediately.
Besides, I really love you.
From now on, I will honor our mother with you! "
Liu Ping continued.
"Thank you for your like. I don't accept it. You are too ugly."
Ye Qianwen said coldly.
